summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Nirmala Home Foods landing site. Backend (8 pytest tests) and frontend (sections, hero, WhatsApp links, pricing, snacks table, how-to-order, nav scroll, min-order banner, floating WA, contact form empty + valid submit with DB persistence, no console errors) all PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: OrderCreate has no explicit length validation — FastAPI will accept any non-empty strings (after strip). Consider Pydantic Field(min_length=...) and phone regex for robustness (nice-to-have).

Backend: Order model uses `created_at: datetime` with `response_model=List[Order]`. After writing ISO string to Mongo and parsing back to datetime on read, responses are normalized — good. If orders collection contains legacy entries without `created_at`, Pydantic will fail; consider Optional[datetime] as a safety net.
Frontend: ContactForm axios POST has no explicit Content-Type/timeout; fine today since backend accepts JSON. Minor.

UX: Hero title renders as 'Nirmala' + block span 'Home Foods' (two lines). textContent reads 'NirmalaHome Foods' with no space — visually correct, but if any SEO/automation scrapes textContent they'd see concatenation. Non-blocking.
MinOrderBanner: fixed top-[60px] / md:top-[68px] is hardcoded to nav height. If nav padding changes it may overlap. Consider CSS variable.
Hero scroll-hint overlaps the CTA area on shorter viewports — cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ / UITest_ prefixed orders in Mongo `orders` collection via API during tests. Safe to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers GET /api/, POST /api/orders (happy + 4 validation variants), GET /api/orders (no _id, reverse-chrono), and post-create persistence. Frontend is a single landing page; key data-testids: site-navbar, min-order-banner, hero-section, hero-whatsapp-btn, hero-view-menu-btn, nonveg-card-0..6, veg-card-0..2, snacks-table, snack-row-0..18, how-step-0..3, contact-form, contact-name-input/contact-phone-input/contact-items-input/contact-notes-input, contact-submit-btn, floating-whatsapp-btn, footer-whatsapp-link, footer-instagram-link, nav-non-veg/nav-veg/nav-snacks/nav-how/nav-contact. When asserting scroll positions, use getBoundingClientRect intersection with viewport — not absolute y<200 — because the page is tall.
